items.title: 52035_Eddie Durham oral history interview
items.q: I think Willie Pratt sent for me, and that's when he had the band -- and Billy Carter was in his band. Teddy Wilson and Cozy Coles and Battles.

ctx.x: Well, after this period with Edgar Battle, what do you think happened then?
Battles went with Georgia's White Bryant, or either Willie Pratt or somebody.
Now, that's a good bit later.
